verdict.rationale: Radar gives analysts review actions (approve via POST /v1/reviews/:id/approve) and lists that rules can reference, such as trusted customer IDs and value lists. That offers a manual way to push case outcomes into rules, and early fraud warnings surface issuer fraud signals. Nothing in the evidence says review decisions or confirmed fraud outcomes retrain or feed back into the ML model. Missing for 10: documented model learning from review decisions, automatic feedback of confirmed fraud and disputes into scoring, automatic rule or list updates from case outcomes, and independent corroboration of any learning loop.
